revolve_profile.limits: GPU full 2pi revolution of a simple CCW closed positive-radius RZ profile, <=32 corners. Native CAD supports a planar closed face and arbitrary axis/angle; mesh is a separate faceted preview.

boolean_union.limits: CPU OCCT fuse of valid native B-reps; no GPU Boolean claim; failures raise.

boolean_cut.limits: CPU native A minus B; input topology must be valid; the result may legitimately be empty.

boolean_common.limits: CPU native intersection, including valid empty intersection; distinct from untrimmed surface intersection.

delete_faces.limits: GPU triangle-mask deletion compacts triangles but leaves vertex storage; CAD deletion takes an open/closed shell, not a solid that would become invalid. Does not automatically cap holes.

fill_hole.limits: Single simple planar boundary, <=64 mesh vertices; loop opposes remaining halfedges; 1e-12 weld tolerance. Native planar cap can then be sewn. Curved filling uses the separate fill_nside primitive.

smooth_laplacian.limits: Uniform adjacency Laplacian, <=512 vertices/1024 triangles, 1..64 iterations, 0<lambda<1; boundaries move and volume can shrink.

smooth_taubin.limits: Alternating lambda/mu uniform Laplacian, -1<mu<0; bounded mesh as above. Reduces shrinkage in the fixture but does not guarantee exact volume preservation.
